policy: Official picks use Hubáček gates: decorrelated model beats the de-vigged market by >= 2 pp, honest EV >= 2% (calibrated pre-decorrelation probability), and a per-bet-type confidence bar (20 pp moneyline, 10 pp baseball/soccer, 5 pp spread cover). Live thresholds live in web/hubacek_picks.py; per-league overrides (min_market_gap_pp, min_win_confidence_pp, min_ev_pct, ml_lo/ml_hi) are stored here from walk-forward bet backtests.

mlb.note: MLB v2 walk-forward backtest (scripts/backtest_mlb_bets.py): raw model-market gap >= 6 pp (6.7 pp after 1.12x decorrelation), prices -200..+200. Opening-line ROI +35% (2024-2026, CLV +21.8%); closing-line floor -3.2%. Bets recorded in the morning sit between those brackets.

nhl.note: NHL v2 walk-forward backtest (scripts/backtest_nhl_bets.py): raw model-market gap >= 7 pp (7.8 pp after 1.12x decorrelation), prices -250..+250. Opening-line ROI +5.7% with all 3 open-odds seasons positive (2023-2025, CLV +3.96%, 71% positive-CLV bets); closing-line 12-season ROI +1.96%. Bets recorded in the morning sit between the open and close.
